instruction: I want to enable automatic BCC to myself for all outgoing emails. Could you help me configure Thunderbird to automatically add my email address in the BCC field?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic BCC by setting mail.identity.id1.doBcc to true. Currently in prefs.js (line 60), this is set to false. The task configures Thunderbird to automatically add the user's email in BCC field for outgoing messages.
metadata.verification: Verified in prefs.js line 60 that mail.identity.id1.doBcc is currently false. Task will change it to true to enable auto-BCC functionality.
